product_one_liner.value: Druid provides an enterprise AI-agent platform that helps organizations automate customer and employee workflows across chat, SMS, voice, and email while integrating with their business systems.
product_one_liner.notes: Product description and use case are stated in Druid AI’s announcement.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes custom pricing plans and invites visitors to request a tailored quote.

named_customers.notes: All three are identified as customers in the company’s customer-story section.

employee_band.notes: The company careers page reports a team of over 190 people worldwide.

hq_location.notes: The company LinkedIn profile lists its headquarters as New York, NY.

founded_year.notes: The company says it was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is an editorial and customer-use-case resource; the surfaced reference-model post discusses agent evaluation rather than how Druid’s product is built, and the evidence does not show two engineer-authored technical build posts.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site has multiple product guides, integration articles, and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job board lists an open Speech AI Engineer role, posted about two weeks before the November 2026 check.

model_provider.value: LLM-agnostic and configurable: public documentation names OpenAI, Mistral AI, Google Vertex AI, and AWS Bedrock, as well as LLaMA and Druid’s private Becus models, among other supported options.
model_provider.notes: Druid describes configurable provider choice rather than one fixed model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR.

last_funding.notes: Druid AI and its Series C lead identify the September 16, 2025 round as $31 million. A later investor portfolio page contains an inconsistent, unsupported $50 million claim; the official company and round-lead announcements and current funding inventories support the September 2025 round.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 Series C occurred within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Account Executive listing is shown as open through November 14, 2026, so it was live on November 9.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 14, 2026, Druid announced new voice, agent-interoperability, governance, and evaluation capabilities, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The documented CEO appointment was September 2025, before the Nov. 9, 2025–Nov. 9, 2026 window; the VP profile says she joined Druid as a Product Owner about five years earlier. No C-level or VP-level join or departure within the window was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations documentation explicitly names Salesforce as an enterprise platform supported by Druid connectors.
